youtube.aciklama: In the frequency pattern test, two tones, one high and one low, are arranged into sequences of three, and the person says the sequence in words. Labeling a pattern requires the right hemisphere to perceive it and the left hemisphere to put it into language; so even with a cortical lesion in one hemisphere, scores often drop in both ears, while humming it back correctly points to a problem with interhemispheric transfer.
